# Gentle Dental

> > Gentle Dental connects patients with expert, affordable dentists offering comprehensive general, preventative, cosmetic, and orthodontic care through a convenient clinic locator.

Gentle Dental is a dental services network featuring multiple locations including clinics in Washington and Klamath Falls, staffed by experienced dentists like Dr. Tina, Dr. Silpa, Dr. Fletcher, and Dr. Buddulla. The platform specializes in patient-centered care with options for anxiety-free sedation dentistry and a full range of treatments from preventative cleanings to advanced orthodontics.
